intent: for the URL of an English Wikipedia article, give back its title, its summary paragraph and the albums in its Discography section

in.name: url
in.text: the URL of an English Wikipedia article

out.type: (record end (one-of done error) reason (maybe str) title (maybe str) url (maybe str) summary (maybe str) albums (maybe (list (tuple str int))))
out.text: end is done or error; on done, the title, url, summary and albums as [title, year]

rules.label: Time to wait for each request

flow.name: Wikipedia URL
flow.ensure: wiki-title of the URL is not empty

flow.name: Summary
flow.do: GET the REST summary of the title; keep the extract; stop after {http.timeout} seconds

flow.name: Summary received
flow.ensure: the status is OK and the extract is not empty

flow.name: Discography
flow.do: GET the wikitext of the section named Discography; if the article has no such section, use an empty text

flow.name: Albums
flow.do: read the albums from the wikitext with album-list
